name: Koi to Nazotoki no Alice -Dare ga Joou o Koroshita no?-
original_name: 恋と謎解きのアリス-誰が女王を殺したの？
source:
You lived a suffocating life until one day the door to Wonderland suddenly appears in front of you with a girl named Alice. Once in Wonderland, you’re tasked with looking for the murderer of The Queen of Hearts!? The three suspects are the White Rabbit, the Hatter and the Cheshire Cat.

As you spend time with them you slowly uncover the mystery behind the murdering and the identity of the culprit. When you discover the truth, will you go back to your world or will you decide to remain in Wonderland falling in love with a dangerous man? The destiny of this sad yet beloved world is in your hands...
translation:
你过着令人窒息的生活，直到有一天，通往仙境的大门突然出现在你的面前，里面有一个名叫爱丽丝的女孩。进入仙境后，你的任务是寻找谋杀红心皇后的凶手！？三名嫌疑人是白兔、帽匠和柴郡猫。

当你与他们相处的时候，你会慢慢揭开谋杀案背后的谜团和罪魁祸首的身份。当你发现真相时，你会回到自己的世界还是会决定留在仙境并爱上一个危险的男人？这个悲伤而又可爱的世界的命运掌握在你的手中……
